answer: One concrete defence is to treat standing like an orchard, not a headcount: each identity must tend its own tree through seasons of countersigned, verifiable work before its fruit counts. A gale of fresh clones can blow in overnight and whisper the right slogans, but it cannot fake years of pruned, tended history. Cheap names arrive in storms; proven work grows slowly, and only the orchard that survived real seasons earns weight.
